c: When you type any dbt command, dbt first does the
of the project: it reads every file and renders the Jinja of every model, test, snapshot and analysis. Why render everything? Because dbt must discover each
call to build the manifest and the DAG. At this moment dbt does not want to query the warehouse (it would be slow, and the tables may not exist yet). So during parsing the special variable
nodes, in DAG order, and renders their Jinja
. Now queries are allowed, and the result is sent to the warehouse.

blocks.alt: dbt renders Jinja twice. Project files (.sql and .yml) → 1. parse: renders all Jinja with execute = False (no query is sent: run_query returns nothing) → manifest and DAG (who refs whom) → 2. execute: renders again with execute = True, only for the selected nodes → the warehouse runs the SQL.
